question: In a certain code language, if SMOOTHIE is written as UKQMVFKC, then how will HEAVENLY be written as in the same code language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

SMOOTHIE is written as UKQMVFKC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f854f37df719fe2558ec46a5269e04327ed6f58a6c96186b6667f28c89ae54d7.png] 

Similarly,

**HEAVENLY = ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eca76c39408605b04b6b32ccbdfa40b36ba42e01a4f047c05c3bfd83d714ddf5.png] 

Hence, 'HEAVENLY' is coded as "**JCCTGLNW**".
